scope: Two matched-capacity shared-query networks, AB/C development only. Frozen original temporal reader remains read-only reference. No newD, newbackbone, controller change, planning run or extra data.

architecture.common: Frozen old96d temporal object/scene nodes concatenated with96d current spatial nodes; shared384to32 patch projection; object8slots*32+12bbox to96; scene32slots*32+15proprio to96. Shared typed query [a,b,a-b,a*b,type16]784->128LN/GELU->64GELU->1, drawer3 queries jointly softmax. Five relation types, nine facts.
architecture.pooled: Object4patch mean repeated4; scene4x4 reduced2x2 then repeated to4x4. Old temporal representation retained.
architecture.spatial: Original object2x2 and scene4x4 slots retained, no fine patch averaging. Old temporal representation retained.
architecture.initialization: Both arms load same initial semantic query selected600; original head columns copied; new spatial columns initializedzero, yielding same initial logits. All new module weights seed0 and identical across arms.
architecture.missing_RGB_object_ROI: zeroed by current-frame RGB visibility, no hidden-location imputation
architecture.anchors: drawer/gripper use typed scene anchors, not claimed segmented 3D instances.

training.sampling: Same stored root-uniform schedule for both arms,16newAB+16legacyAB eachstep; rng170151.
training.loss: Same AB-weighted HoldingBCE,InBCE,drawerCE, meanoverpresentgroups. No41-subset-specific loss, no paired loss, noC gradient.
training.selection: Per arm min newCrootmacrogroup loss+0.2oldCHoldingrootmacro loss, ties earlier; no result-specific checkpoint switching.
training.budget_stop: Complete two fixed runs. No rerun seed, extra updates or tuning if failed. Runtime fixes may resume only preserving evidence.
